title: How Armstrong sees himself, audiences and records
summary: Armstrong describes himself as one of the audience, discusses changing audiences and records, and why he has lasted so long.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand
